name: The Powers of the UFO Religions (collective)
note: Hub collective grouping the benevolent extraterrestrial powers venerated or believed-in across practiced UFO religions (Raelism, Heaven's Gate, the contactee/channeling milieu). Modeled neutrally as the beings sincerely held to exist within these traditions.

name: The Space Brothers
dom: benevolent guidance; cosmic warning; uplift of humanity
note: The benevolent, spiritually advanced extraterrestrials of the 1950s contactee movement (Adamski, Van Tassel, etc.); believed by contactees and channelers to deliver messages of peace and warning. Sincerely held within the contactee/channeling milieu.

name: Ashtar (Ashtar Galactic Command)
dom: galactic command; cosmic guardianship; channeled guidance
note: The extraterrestrial commander first channeled by George Van Tassel (1952) and central to the ongoing Ashtar channeling current; head of the Ashtar Galactic Command. Held to exist and actively channeled within the milieu. NOTE homonym: unrelated to the Moabite Ashtar-Kemosh (ENT_MOA_ASHTAR_KEMOSH).

name: The Council of Nine ("the Nine" / "Tom")
dom: cosmic governance; channeled wisdom; creation oversight
note: Nine cosmic beings (spokesman 'Tom') channeled through the Andrija Puharich circle from the 1950s onward; influential across the channeling milieu and sincerely received as higher intelligences. Modeled neutrally as beliefs held within the tradition.

name: The Raelian Elohim
dom: creation of humanity by genetic engineering; future return
note: The extraterrestrial creators of the active Raelian movement, held to have engineered humanity in their laboratories; 'Elohim' read as 'those who came from the sky.' Core sincerely-held belief of practicing Raelians. NOTE homonym: distinct from Hebrew/Jewish/LDS Elohim (ENT_ISR_BENE_ELOHIM / ENT_JM_ELOHIM_RANK / ENT_LDS_ELOHIM).

name: Sananda
note: The channeled 'cosmic Jesus' of the Ashtar/I AM-adjacent channeling current, presented as the higher self/galactic identity of Jesus; sincerely received and channeled within the milieu.

name: The Next Level (Heaven's Gate)
dom: evolutionary level above human; extraterrestrial kingdom
note: Heaven's Gate's term for 'The Evolutionary Level Above Human,' the extraterrestrial kingdom to which members believed they would graduate; sincerely lived belief of the Heaven's Gate community.

name: Ti and Do (Bonnie Nettles & Marshall Applewhite)
note: Co-founders of Heaven's Gate, believed by members to be incarnated representatives of the Next Level (Do also identified with the returned Jesus-soul). Sincerely venerated as guides by the community. Modeled neutrally.
